display.purpose: One h1 per page, Bricolage Grotesque 800.

caption.purpose: Screenshot caption, Geist 0.875rem muted; always starts with "Exemplo:".

shadows.name: window-ground
shadows.purpose: Lifts the single raised application window off the navy ground.

shadows.name: button-glow
shadows.purpose: Faint green glow under the primary button.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Background, border, 1px lift on buttons; the only motion on the page, removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Application Window
components.description: Frames a real capture of the app's /pdv screen (demo data) with an "Exemplo:" caption. The one raised surface. Real capture only, never a mock-up.

components.name: Question Row
components.description: Native details with green plus marker.

narrative.overview: A night-time bookkeeping page: deep navy ground, ruled lines instead of boxes, and one green that means action. The hero proves the product with a real capture of the /pdv screen in an application window. Desktop-first; mobile stacks the same single column.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal layering with hairline rules
Real product capture in an application window as the one raised surface
No authored motion; only a button hover transition

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green marks an action or a confirmed state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every money figure and counter the landing sets uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The One Raised Surface Rule
rules.body: Only the application window is raised.

rules.name: The Real Capture Rule
rules.body: The product screen must be a real capture of the app with demo data, and always carries the "Exemplo:" caption. public/landing/pdv-desktop.webp: Playwright capture of the built app's /pdv at 1280x760, device scale 1.5, invented demo data via intercepted API responses, WebP, about 100 KB; nothing from production or real customers.

dos: Do show the product through a real demo-data capture with the "Exemplo:" caption.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for any motion added.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use rows of same-size icon cards.
Don't draw an imitation of the product screen or use real-customer data.
